$comment: Numeric and color token authority for the web shell and the Pen library. Colors carry a Dark value and a Light value, the Neutral color theme's; a color the Hide color theme draws differently also carries `hide` with its own Dark `value` and `light`, and every other color is shared by both color themes. An alias names another token. node scripts/gen-tokens.mjs writes web/src/tokens.css from this file.

--dialog.$comment: A modal's surface (dialog, alert, sheet): darker than a menu, so a menu opened inside it stands above it.

--dialog-raised.$comment: A filled control on a modal's surface: the modal sets --secondary and --accent to it, so a secondary button or a hovered row stays distinct from the darker surface.

--dialog-hover.$comment: A hovered row or a pressed control on a modal's surface: one step above --dialog-raised, so a modal's secondary control still lights on hover.

--elevation-raised.$comment: Level 1: a control or chip that sits on its surface (a keycap, a dragged tab). Dark leans on the fill step, so its shadow only grounds the edge.

--elevation-overlay.$comment: Level 2: a layer that floats over the page without blocking it (menu, popover, select, tooltip, toast, a floating panel). Dark adds a faint light rim because a dark shadow does not read on a dark page; Light, where a popover and a modal share white, tells them apart by shadow.

--elevation-modal.$comment: Level 3: a modal (dialog, alert, sheet) over its scrim.

--scrim.$comment: The veil under a modal, the same for a dialog, an alert and a sheet: it darkens the page in both modes instead of washing Light out with the page color.

--raised.$comment: A small object lifted off its surface by a shadow rather than a gray fill (a graph node): the secondary step in Dark, white in Light, always drawn with shadow-raised.

--terminal-letter-text.$comment: The words of a doorbell letter's rows in a pane's terminal (docs/UI_BEHAVIOR.md, The doorbell's lines in a terminal): a blue-grey, apart from the amber of Needs You, readable on --terminal-letter-band.

--terminal-letter-band.$comment: The band behind a letter's rows: rgb(80, 140, 170) at 16% over --background, mixed once here because the terminal's background color has no alpha. Neutral Dark, Neutral Light, then Hide Dark and Light over their own --background.

--size-picker-popover.$comment: A searchable picker a chip opens, such as the start panel's project and branch menus: wide enough for a project or branch name beside its marks.

--size-start-text-max.$comment: The start panel's text grows with what is written up to about six lines, then scrolls, so the where and who rows stay in reach.

--size-start-branch-field.$comment: The start panel's new-branch name field: a typical branch name fits beside its base and cancel on the where row.

--size-turn-card.$comment: The pane's turn card: a letter line (direction, peer, mark, first line, time) and an opened answer with a table fit without wrapping every line; the popover still stops at the available width.

--size-turn-card-answer.$comment: The tallest an opened answer grows on the turn card before it scrolls in its own box, so the letters under it stay in view.

--practice-accent.$comment: The practice window's guide: its ring, buttons and checks, a soft amber the shell never draws, the same in Light and Dark.
